test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

M_O_ _N O_ _N_P M_O_

options.text: N P M P M O N P
N P O P M O P O
N P M P M P M N
O P M P M O P M

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: M_O_ _N O_ _N_P M_O_

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) **N P M P M O N P** → M__**N**__O__**P**__ / __**M**__NO__P__ / __M__N**__O__**P / M__N__O__P__

Here, 'Option 1' followed a pattern.

Option 2) N P O P M O P O → M__N__O__P__ / **__O__**NO__P__ / __M__N__O__P / M**__P__**O**__O__**

Option 3) N P M P M P M N → M__N__O__P__ / __M__NO__P__ / __M__N**__P__**P / M**__M__**O**__N__**

Option 4) O P M P M O P M → M**__O__**O__P__ / __M__NO__P__ / __M__N__O__P / M**__P__**O**__M__**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
